skills.name: diagnostic.go_diagnose
skills.description: Analyze Go compile/build errors and return fixed source files. Receives the full `go build` stderr output and the content of affected files. Uses LLM to identify root causes and generate complete corrected files. Falls back to a structured analysis report when LLM is unavailable.

parameters.name: error_output
parameters.description: Full output from `go build ./...` or `go run`

parameters.name: source_files
parameters.description: JSON array of affected files: [{"path": "...", "content": "..."}]. Include all files mentioned in the error output.

parameters.name: module_name
parameters.description: Go module name from go.mod (e.g. github.com/org/service)

skills.name: diagnostic.nextjs_diagnose

parameters.name: error_output
parameters.description: Full output from `next build` or `npx tsc --noEmit`

parameters.name: source_files
parameters.description: JSON array of affected files: [{"path": "...", "content": "..."}]. Include all .tsx/.ts files mentioned in the error output.

skills.name: diagnostic.python_diagnose

parameters.name: error_output
parameters.description: Full Python traceback or stderr output (e.g. from `python app.py` or `uvicorn main:app`)

parameters.name: source_files
parameters.description: JSON array of affected files: [{"path": "...", "content": "..."}]. Include all .py files referenced in the traceback.
